mapontosevenths
children.text:
Usually I do it when one of them is stumped on their own, or seems to be thrashing. I guess it's more like... adjacent to the main loop.

I'll spin up both TUI's in herdr, tell them both to run "hc --skill" and then talk to each other until they figure out a solution. Also, for really complex tasks I will give one of them the title "Advisor" and just leave it running in the background while the main agent runs. The main agent gets instructions to ask the Advisor when stuck. So far it's basically always worked.

Before herdr I had them use tmux and files to talk to each other. That works too, but with a little more fumbling.
How do you have them interacting in a loop?  Plan-execute-repeat?  Execute-review-repeat?

The name is probably a clue. I wonder if someone just bolted Fable to Astra in a loop? I do that when I'm stuck, and get great results that exceed what either can do alone... Though it is wickedly expensive.
Very curious to find out which model that is :O
